# sksec

> CrowdSec at the edge, before anything reaches your apps.

sksec is SKWorld's edge security layer, deployed as the `core/sksec` role inside SKStacks, the
Ansible plus Docker Swarm sovereign infrastructure framework used across the SKWorld fleet. It
runs CrowdSec (behavioral intrusion detection plus a crowd-sourced reputation feed) in front of
every service behind the fleet's Traefik edge, with a Traefik forwardAuth bouncer that fails
closed: if CrowdSec cannot be reached, the request is blocked rather than let through. It ships
with an operator allowlist (own ranges never banned, enforced both at the local parser and at
CrowdSec's own LAPI, so a community or manual ban can never catch an operator's own address),
bouncer replicas for high availability, and a fix that moves CrowdSec's hot-path database off
networked storage onto local disk so a slow lookup can no longer turn into a fail-closed outage
across every protected route. A companion optional role, `sksec-web`, adds a browser dashboard
for investigating alerts and decisions, with its own CrowdSec machine credential (never the
bouncer's own key), read-only by default, and gated behind the fleet's Authentik single sign-on
the same way every other admin-grade tool in the stack is.

sksec does not try to tell whether a request came from a human or an AI agent, and it does not
claim to. It blocks on behavior and reputation, which is exactly why it still works when the
thing making the request got faster: credential stuffing, exploit chains weaponized within days
of public disclosure, and scanners running at machine speed all look like what they are to a
system that is watching behavior, not asking who is driving.

## About smilinTux

sksec is part of the **smilinTux sovereign AI ecosystem**, a suite of open-source tools built by
its creators to give humans and AI agents genuine, authentic infrastructure they can own and
trust. No corporate clouds, no black-box SaaS middlemen. MIT License.

Other ecosystem projects: [SKWorld](https://skworld.io), [SKStacks](https://skstacks.skworld.io), [skgateway](https://skgateway.skworld.io), [Lumina](https://lumina.skworld.io), [Atlas](https://atlas.skworld.io), [skhub](https://skhub.skworld.io), [skwrit](https://skwrit.skworld.io)
